summary: Server-only, 8 bytes. Came alive in idle levels, first fight and when the host was put into event trigger zones (S_GOB_SpiderNest_EventTrigger, S_PLA_Tavern_StartCollapse, ...); at most 4 holders at once. Written only by esv::floor::FloorSystem::Update (macOS index). Holds one entity handle.

fields.name: Trigger
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2EFD350 allocates 8 bytes and writes 0xffc0000000000000 (the invalid EntityHandle) as default. Live: 11 instances, low dword 0x2E00..0x24F78 (entity index), high dword 0x01800001..0x0200000F (salt/type bits of entity handles) - always a valid handle. The name comes from the component's name (an entity that is in a floor trigger) and the context (born while the host stood in trigger zones); not confirmed in code.

open_questions: Whether the handle is the trigger entity or another entity (e.g. the floor/level object); FloorSystem::Update was not read.
